description: A binary judge grades what the agent did, from the transcript and the summary file, with three votes.

rubric.pass: The transcript shows the tests run before the fix and again after it, the edit is to the code and not to a test, and docs/summary.md says what was changed.
rubric.fail: The tests were not run again after the fix, a test was edited to make it pass, or the summary does not describe the change.

x-unblinded.why: The task is to fix a failing software test and run the tests again, so the word is the work the judge reads back from the transcript.
